text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from NT$104,088 to NT$96,539 despite several periods without trading; doing nothing avoids impulsive decisions, but I should still review whether my holdings and risk remain appropriate.","Ten months of uneven returns are not enough to infer a lasting trend, so I should avoid chasing short-term price moves and base trades on a clear long-term rationale.","Losses affect me more than gains, so I should make any portfolio changes calmly and deliberately rather than letting recent declines alone drive a decision."]}
